params.usdc_: ERC-20 token address to pull from payer and pay recipients.

distribute(address[],uint256[],uint256).details: Pulls `totalAmount` from the payer via transferFrom, then pays recipients.      The final recipient receives the remainder to absorb integer division rounding.

params.sharesBps: Share weights in basis points (must sum to 10_000).

constructor.notice: Sets the USDC token address used for all distributions.

distribute(address[],uint256[],uint256).notice: Splits a USDC payment from msg.sender across recipients by basis-point shares.
